note: Set B captures the full revision table (five revisions with dates and descriptions) plus the lot number 116, all correctly bound and quoted, which Set A omits entirely despite being major content of the title block. Set A's ten claims are mostly sound on scales and elevations but contain three duplicate pairs and one quote padded with invented text ("Detail A1: 3/8\" = 1'-0\""). Set B's errors are the two invented "Bedroom 4" adjacency claims (no such label exists on the sheet) and the misbound project-name claim (that text is the client/logo block, not a stated project name), plus a couple of trivial room-layout claims and one duplicate elevation. On balance B's correct coverage of revisions and lot number outweighs its few errors.
